measurement: close before print to close after first full session following it
note: Independent re-panel of the same ABM/UNFI event already panelled on 2026-09-04 (window rolled through the Labor Day holiday). Same realised outcome as that run; scored separately because it is a separate, independently-sourced forecast made one day closer to the print.

names.direction_hit_note: Neutral-hit convention: actual 7.55% is essentially identical to the panel's 7.4% expectation, inside the 3.7-11.8% band, below the 8.4% implied move.
names.reversal_note: Red-team's own 'what would break my reversal case' scenario -- 'a Q3 print at or above $1.04 with segment operating margin up year over year, plus a narrowing of FY26 guidance into the upper half and a third straight quarter of positive FCF' -- is close to exactly what happened: EPS printed at $1.04, guidance narrowed with the floor raised, FCF guide raised. The persona's own bearish call (-20) was wrong; the scenario it flagged as the thing that would flip it was the scenario that happened.
names.guidance: FY26 adj EPS narrowed to 3.95-4.10 (from 3.85-4.15, floor raised); FY26 FCF guide raised to ~$210M from $185M

names.direction_hit_note: Neutral-hit convention: actual 2.28% came in far below the panel's 10.4% expectation and the 11.7% implied move.
names.reversal_note: Neither the red-team's downside case (June-2026-style beat-but-no-raise sell-off) nor its named upside break scenario (a real squeeze on a strong FY27 guide plus refreshed buyback) fired at scale -- the reaction was muted in both directions.
